subject: Matemática e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas de contagem envolvendo agrupamentos ordenáveis ou não de elementos, por meio dos princípios multiplicativo e aditivo, recorrendo a estratégias diversas, como o diagrama de árvore.

components.description_pt: Aplicar o Princípio Multiplicativo para contar resultados de eventos com múltiplas etapas
components.description_en: Apply the Multiplication Principle to count outcomes of multi-step events
components.cc_component_description: Use the Multiplication Principle to decide if two events are independent and to calculate conditional probabilities

components.description_pt: Aplicar o Princípio Aditivo para contar resultados de eventos mutuamente exclusivos
components.description_en: Apply the Addition Principle to count outcomes of mutually exclusive events
components.cc_component_description: Identify two events as disjoint (mutually exclusive)

components.description_pt: Usar diagramas de árvore para enumerar arranjos ordenados e não ordenados de elementos
components.description_en: Use tree diagrams to enumerate ordered and unordered arrangements of elements

components.description_pt: Determinar se permutações ou combinações seriam úteis em um contexto e usá-las para resolver problemas reais
components.description_en: Determine whether permutations or combinations would be useful in a context and use them to solve real-world problems
components.cc_component_description: Determine whether permutations or combinations would be useful in a context and use them to solve real-world problems

components.description_pt: Resolver e criar problemas de contagem usando os Princípios Multiplicativo e Aditivo
components.description_en: Solve and create counting problems using the Multiplication and Addition Principles

cc_matches.description: (+) Use permutations and combinations to compute probabilities of compound events and solve problems.

Understand the conditional probability of A given B as $\frac{P(A and B)}{P(B)}$, and interpret independence of A and B as saying that the conditional probability of A given B is the same as the probability of A, and the conditional probability of B given A is the same as the probability of B.
Apply the Addition Rule, P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A and B), and interpret the answer in terms of the model.
